newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Heavy rains bring floods to eastern Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Heavy rains bring floods to eastern Colombia.

text.p: Military helicopters and scores of Red Cross workers plucked at least 200 families to safety as heavy rains brought floods to part of eastern Colombia, authorities said on Sunday.

The River Upia in Casanare province has risen more than 12 feet (3 metres) after five days of torrential rains and has cut off communities near the town of Villanueva, a spokesman for the government's Prevention of Disasters Office said.
"The rising river formed little islands. We still have about 70 families to rescue," Diego Francisco Zubieta of the disaster office told the NTC TV news programme.
Heavy rains also caused flooding in neighbouring Boyaca province. No fatalities were reported but roads were washed out and bridges were destroyed by floodwaters, NTC said.
